text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Crisis atmosphere prevails over Jordanian-Israeli relations: Jordan's ambassador to Israel says ties have deteriorated because Tel Aviv "had steered away from the general line of the peace process."

- Jordanian officials meet Saudi billionare investor Prince al-Waleed bin Talal bin Abdul Aziz and discuss possibilities of cooperation between Jordanian and Saudi institutions in joint investments and industries.
- Jordan occupies a leading position among countries contributing to U.N. peacekeeping forces.
- Israeli papers express their concern about the consequences of King Hussein's "disappointment" with Israel,
- Prime Minister Kabariti gets another phone call from the U.S. peace coordinator Ross to brief him on pace of progress in Israeli-Palestinian talks.
- Tourism minister returns from Thailand after discussions with Thai officials on boosting tourism cooperation between the two states.
